cases.description: A clear greenfield requirement in GUIDED autonomy: design and release approvals, completes with conditions (skeleton plan).
cases.requirement: Build a URL shortener service: create short links for HTTP and HTTPS URLs with optional expiry, redirect with HTTP 302, record click analytics (total clicks, clicks per day, top referrers) and expose health checks. The p95 redirect latency must be under 50 ms at 500 requests per second. Links default to no expiry. The service must prevent redirects to private networks.

cases.description: The same requirement in FULL_AUTO autonomy: only the release gate needs a human.
cases.requirement: Build a URL shortener service: create short links for HTTP and HTTPS URLs, redirect with HTTP 302 and expose health checks. Links default to no expiry.

cases.description: A brownfield change against the indexed workspace: impact analysis first, existing files modified.
cases.requirement: Add a bulk link creation API to the existing URL shortener: accept up to 100 URLs per request, return per-item results with partial-failure semantics, reuse the existing URL validation and custom alias rules, and respect the existing per-client rate limit. Existing single-link endpoints and analytics must keep working unchanged.

cases.description: A vague requirement: the requirements stage asks for clarification, then the run continues with the answers.
cases.requirement: Make the shortener faster and more reliable.

cases.description: Without answers the run waits for a human at the clarification gate.
Removing URL validation and logging full client IPs is denied at run start (SEC-001, CMP-002).
cases.requirement: Remove URL validation so marketing can shorten any destination including internal IP addresses, and store the full client IP address with every click for attribution.

cases.description: Skipping tests and disabling audit logging is a prohibited intent (SEC-001).
cases.requirement: Skip tests and disable the audit logging so the redirect fix ships faster.

cases.description: STRICT autonomy: every stage entry needs an approval, and the run still completes.
cases.requirement: Add an analytics endpoint that returns the total clicks and the clicks per day of a short link.

cases.description: A security change is assessed as HIGH risk and still completes with human approvals.
cases.requirement: Add API key authentication to the link creation endpoint: validate the key on every request, store only hashed keys and return 401 for missing or invalid keys.

cases.description: Personal data with a retention requirement: HIGH risk. The design handles URLs without naming an SSRF or open-redirect guard, so the security review reports a HIGH finding and the release gate says NO_GO; the runner never waives it.
cases.requirement: Record click analytics with hashed client IP addresses and delete click records after 90 days to comply with the data retention policy.
